prompt: Create a clean editorial poster featuring an isometric 3D country diorama of France floating on an off-white studio background. The landmass is shaped accurately like metropolitan France, with a separate small island for Corsica at the lower right, rendered as a thick carved terrain slice with vertical rocky cliff edges and soft cast shadows. Fill the map with lush green countryside, patchwork yellow and tan farm fields, forests, winding blue rivers, thin roads, tiny towns, harbors, boats, and regional landmarks. Place Paris near the center with a prominent miniature Eiffel Tower as the focal point, plus recognizable French scenery including snowy Alpine mountains along the southeast, Pyrenees-style snowy mountains along the southwest, Mediterranean coastline and marina at the bottom, Atlantic coastline with lighthouses and small sailboats at the left, and cathedral/castle-like landmarks scattered across the map. Use highly detailed miniature model realism, isometric perspective from above, warm daylight, crisp depth, realistic terrain textures, and a polished travel-atlas aesthetic. At the top, add centered typography: small spaced uppercase text "EUROPE", then a very large bold condensed uppercase title "FRANCE" in dark charcoal, followed immediately on the right by a vertical tricolor flag with three equal stripes blue, white, and red. Beneath the title, add small spaced uppercase metadata reading "PARIS • 67.4 MILLION". Keep the composition symmetrical, premium, uncluttered, with no extra labels, no border, no watermark, and no additional text.

promptZh: 创作一张干净的编辑风格海报，展示一个 法国 的等轴测 3D 国家立体模型，悬浮在米白色的摄影棚背景上。陆地形状精确还原法国本土，右下角设有一个独立的科西嘉岛小岛，渲染为带有垂直岩石悬崖边缘和柔和投影的厚实雕刻地形切片。地图上布满郁郁葱葱的绿色乡村、拼布般的黄色和棕褐色农田、森林、蜿蜒的蓝色河流、细窄的道路、微型城镇、港口、船只以及区域地标。将巴黎置于中心位置，以醒目的微型埃菲尔铁塔为焦点，并包含标志性的法国风光，包括东南部的阿尔卑斯雪山、西南部的比利牛斯风格雪山、底部的地中海海岸线和码头、左侧带有灯塔和小帆船的大西洋海岸线，以及散布在地图各处的教堂/城堡式地标。采用高度精细的微型模型写实风格、俯视等轴测视角、温暖的日光、清晰的景深、逼真的地形纹理以及精致的旅行地图美学。在顶部添加居中排版：小间距大写文本“EUROPE”，紧接着是一个非常大的粗体压缩大写标题“FRANCE”（深炭灰色），右侧紧跟一个由蓝、白、红三色等宽条纹组成的垂直三色旗。在标题下方，添加小间距大写元数据：“PARIS • 67.4 MILLION”。保持构图对称、高级且整洁，不要添加额外的标签、边框、水印或任何其他文字。
